slots.name: start
slots.about: the starting value in tenths of the base unit, used before anything is logged (650 is 65.0)

slots.name: span
slots.about: how far the slider reaches each way from where it starts, in tenths

slots.name: max_back
slots.about: how many days back the day arrows reach

slots.name: units
slots.about: units to show the value in: id (1 up), short (its word), per (how many of it make one base unit, 1 for the base); 1 or more, the first is chosen at the start

slots.name: day_line
slots.about: the day between the arrows; may read offset (days back from today)

slots.name: change_line
slots.about: the line under the value; may read has_prev, is_up, is_down, change_text and unit_short

slots.name: save_line
slots.about: the save button's words; may read has_day, value_text and unit_short

slots.name: step_up
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one tenth more

slots.name: step_down
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one tenth less, never under one tenth

slots.name: slide
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the slider (value: its place from 0 to 1)

slots.name: pick_unit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: shows the value in that unit (value: it.id)

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the value for the day shown, when it is new or changed

slots.name: remove
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: deletes the day shown's entry

slots.name: back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one day back, up to max_back

slots.name: forward
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one day forward, never past today

empty.shows: the value starts from the start slot (or the day's entry) and the change line has nothing to compare

attention.shows: the save button is bright and says log or update with the value and unit

fallback.shows: the day's entry is already saved: save is dimmed and does nothing, and delete shows

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops swap, snappy and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the chosen unit has a fill and the value names it, the change line says up, down or same in words, and delete is a word
